title: S2a2 packet memory wiring: HOT view plus filtered WARM search feed the gotchas and decisions packet sections in shadow, decision_log kind memory_retrieval, promotion feature memory_tiers (P1, P3, P5 groundwork)
spec:
In orchestrator/spawn.py _packet_body: today the gotchas section comes from memory_recall over notes+bus (up to 5 hits) and the decisions section from grep of decisions.md in the worktree. Add a second source: hot = memory_hot.build (read HOT.md when fresh, i.e. store unchanged since the last build, else rebuild) and warm = memory_store.search(query from task title + scope basenames, kind in (gotcha, decision, architecture), file filter per scope path, limit 8) merged and deduplicated by id, rendered with the same one-line format, capped by [memory].packet_hot_tokens (default 1200, dated comment). Mode [memory].mode (off|shadow|active; add as shadow with a dated comment) and promotion FEATURES entry memory_tiers (orchestrator/promotion.py) with criteria: at least 30 decision_log rows of kind memory_retrieval in 7 days and a measured presented-token reduction with no rise in fix rounds (state the criteria in the feature entry as the other features do). Shadow: present the legacy sections unchanged, compute the tiered sections and record one decision_log row kind memory_retrieval (add it to decision_log.KINDS) with candidates (record ids with tier and score), selected (ids the tiered path would present), legacy_ids (the hits the legacy path presented), tokens_legacy, tokens_tiered, mode, subject task id. Active: present the tiered sections and still record the row. Off: legacy only. packet_meta gains memory_mode and memory_ids. The row must never raise into packet building (guard, log a warning). Docs: docs/hermes-hardening/07-hot-memory.md gains a section on packet wiring and the shadow comparison measured on three real tasks of this repository (ids, tokens_legacy vs tokens_tiered).
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. The interface contracts of the stage 1 modules are in .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and in docs/hermes-hardening/0*.md on this branch; read the merged module before building on it.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_memory_shadow_keeps_legacy_sections_and_logs_row (shadow: legacy text presented, memory_retrieval row with both token counts)
tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_memory_active_presents_tiered_sections (active: HOT and warm hits presented, capped by packet_hot_tokens)
